lens: Recruitment operator — factual comprehension (simulated AI lens)
reason: The public proposition is clear, and the inspected desktop hero coherently uses the Precision Instrument identity. Source tracing supports deliberate cohort advancement, explicit irreversible grading closure, understandable valid-versus-saved results, and per-applicant release recovery. However, the Group Case attention board calls submitted partial observations Complete, contradicting the validity-aware results and closing summary. That factual inconsistency matters when an operator decides whether unfinished work remains before an irreversible freeze. Hold for a focused correction and review. This is an independent AI source/capture assessment, not observed operator success or hosted acceptance.

findings.evidence: The coverage row maps SUBMITTED to Complete. groupCaseCoverageState in src/app/admin/group-case-coverage.ts:12-27 derives that state solely from assignment statuses; its test explicitly accepts SUBMITTED plus LOCKED as complete. In contrast, 20261016191000_grading_contract_consistency.sql:307-339 marks inline Group Case observations and assignments SUBMITTED without requiring observation validity; lines 471-490 explicitly retain partial evidence and require two valid evaluators for a mean. Thus two partial submissions can produce Complete in the attention board while results remain pending.
findings.userImpact: An operator can mistake saved partial observations for finished grading and overlook an applicant who still needs valid evidence before closing a round that cannot reopen through the current workflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Label status-only coverage as observations submitted, or derive Complete and attention ordering from canonical valid independent evaluation counts. Add a regression with two submitted but invalid partial observations and verify consistent wording across coverage, results and close review.

notVerified: No staging, deployed integration or human/operator study exists. Clerk session expiry, hosted RPC/RLS, storage and actual email delivery remain unverified.

The 18 passing operator browser checks intercept HTTP in a synthetic harness; they establish tested confirmation/error behavior, not authenticated production round closure. SQL logs report 709 local assertions; no tests were rerun for this review.

Original-resume identity access is accurately disclosed in inspected application copy; Board policy resolution, retention decisions and client-approved project outcomes remain external dependencies.
